mainEntity.name: What bathroom modifications are essential for an aging parent living space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom accessibility is the top priority when preparing a suite for aging relatives. The most crucial feature is eliminating trip hazards by installing a barrier-free, curbless walk-in shower or completing a tub-to-shower conversion. Additional essentials include reinforcing walls with solid blocking for secure grab bars, widening doorways to allow mobility aids, choosing slip-resistant flooring, and installing comfort-height toilets. Lever-style faucets and handheld showerheads also simplify daily routines. Planning these features early prevents costly structural rework after tile and drywall are already completed.
